audit.skip_reason: Backend (localhost:3001) and Frontend (localhost:5173) unavailable — static mode only

escalations.title: Vitest UI Server Arbitrary File Read / Remote Code Execution
escalations.description: When the Vitest UI server is listening, any unauthenticated network attacker can read arbitrary files from the filesystem and execute arbitrary JavaScript. Sensitive .env files, credentials, and source code are exposed.
escalations.escalation_reason: Dev-environment RCE / sensitive data exposed — requires hardening review beyond a simple version bump

escalations.title: gRPC Server Crash + TLS Certificate Authentication Bypass
escalations.description: Malformed gRPC requests crash the orchestrator server (DoS); malformed compressed messages crash client and server; TLS certificate validation can be bypassed. The orchestrator loses availability and mutual-TLS guarantees.
escalations.fix: npm install @grpc/grpc-js@^1.14.5 in platform/orchestrator (or dockerode@^5.0.1 for full resolution)
escalations.escalation_reason: auth bypass (TLS cert validation bypass) — explicitly listed escalation trigger

p1_findings.title: Traceability Enforcer Scans Wrong Directory — 92% of Requirements Invisible
p1_findings.description: Source dirs hardcoded as ["Source", "E2E"]. All FR-001–089 implementations live in portal/ which is completely excluded. The required verification gate validates only 8% of total requirements.
p1_findings.impact: Traceability gate gives a false green on 92% of the codebase. Spec drift in portal/ is completely undetected.
p1_findings.fix: Add portal/ (and optionally platform/) to scan dirs, or make enforcer read source.dirs from inspector.config.yml

p2_findings.title: FR-070 ID Collision Across Two Plans
p2_findings.description: Two distinct requirements both carry the ID FR-070 (ImageAttachment type vs. OrchestratorCyclesPage). Any Verifies: FR-070 comment is now ambiguous.
p2_findings.fix: Renumber one FR-070; run enforcer to find all affected Verifies: comments and update them

p2_findings.title: Ghost FRs FR-090—095 — Code Written Before Spec
p2_findings.description: Code references FR-090, FR-091, FR-093–095 which appear in no specification or plan. Violates the spec-first mandate.
p2_findings.fix: Write the missing spec sections for FR-090–095 in the appropriate plan, then link them to the code comments

p2_findings.title: Recently-Modified Files With Zero Traceability
p2_findings.description: Both files modified within 14 days, 0 Verifies: annotations. teamDispatches.ts is 85 lines; TeamsPage.tsx is 406 lines.
p2_findings.fix: Add Verifies: FR-XXX comments to every business-logic block; link to the appropriate spec requirements

p2_findings.title: Jest Ecosystem Cascade — 15+ Modules With HIGH CVEs
p2_findings.description: 15+ jest submodules (jest-message-util, jest-resolve, @jest/test-result, etc.) carry HIGH-severity CVEs affecting test suite integrity and CI/CD pipeline. No backport to 29.x.

p2_findings.title: Browserslist Unbounded Memory Growth (DoS)
p2_findings.description: Distinct query results cached indefinitely — eventual OOM. Production frontend builds and CI/CD can exhaust memory.
p2_findings.fix: npm install browserslist@^4.28.7 (transitive via Vite update)

p2_findings.title: path-to-regexp ReDoS in Orchestrator
p2_findings.description: Malformed route patterns cause exponential regex matching — CPU exhaustion, orchestrator API unresponsive.
p2_findings.fix: Upgrade express to ^4.21.0+ in platform/orchestrator (contains patched path-to-regexp)

p2_findings.title: js-yaml Quadratic CPU Consumption (DoS)
p2_findings.description: Repeated aliases and merge-key chains force quadratic CPU — config parsing or spec loading can hang indefinitely.
p2_findings.fix: Upgrade transitive js-yaml to ≥3.15.0 (via jest@^30.5.2 — shares root cause with DEP-002)

p2_findings.title: ws WebSocket Memory Exhaustion (DoS)
p2_findings.description: Tiny WebSocket fragments exhaust server memory; uninitialized memory disclosure possible. Affects Vite dev server HMR.

p2_findings.title: protobufjs Multiple DoS & Schema Injection
p2_findings.description: Unbounded Any expansion, schema-derived names shadowing properties, infinite loop in .proto parsing. Orchestrator gRPC handler hangs on malformed messages.
p2_findings.fix: Upgrade protobufjs to ≥7.7.0+ (transitive via @grpc/grpc-js update — shares root cause with DEP-003)

p3_findings.title: Large Service Files Exceeding 500-Line Threshold
p3_findings.description: 526-line and 506-line service files with mixed responsibilities. Decomposition opportunity.
p3_findings.fix: Split each service into focused sub-services (e.g., separate query vs. mutation logic)

p3_findings.title: eslint-disable Without Explanatory Comments
p3_findings.description: Three recently-modified files suppress react-hooks/exhaustive-deps without rationale. CLAUDE.md prohibits unexplained lint disables.
p3_findings.fix: Add rationale comment or fix the dependency array exhaustiveness issue

p3_findings.title: Enforcer Ignores inspector.config.yml
p3_findings.description: Enforcer hardcodes behavior independent of inspector.config.yml. Config updates have no effect.
p3_findings.fix: Make enforcer read specs.dir and source.dirs from inspector.config.yml (shares root cause with QO-001)

p3_findings.title: react-router Open Redirect via Protocol-Relative URLs
p3_findings.description: Paths beginning with // reinterpreted as protocol-relative URLs, enabling open redirect to attacker-controlled domain.
p3_findings.fix: npm install react-router-dom@^7.18.4 in Source/Frontend and portal/Frontend

p3_findings.title: @vitest/mocker Path Traversal File Read
p3_findings.description: Redirect mocking allows path traversal — arbitrary file read via test runner. Shares fix with DEP-001.
p3_findings.fix: npm install vitest@^5.0.3 (resolves DEP-001 and DEP-008 together)

p3_findings.title: uuid Buffer Bounds Check Missing
p3_findings.description: When buf parameter provided to v3/v5/v6 UUID functions, no length validation — buffer overflow possible.
p3_findings.fix: npm install uuid@^11.1.1 in Backend and portal/Backend; update dockerode@^5.0.1 for orchestrator

p4_findings.title: @babel/core Arbitrary File Read During Transpilation (Low)
p4_findings.description: sourceMappingURL comments can trigger arbitrary file reads during transpilation — requires local dev environment, low exploitability.
p4_findings.fix: Upgrade babel to ≥7.30.0 (typically resolved via TypeScript/build tool update)

cross_references.fix_impact: Resolves 2×P2 (15+ cascading CVEs) with a single command

cross_references.root_cause: gRPC dependency chain outdated in platform/orchestrator
cross_references.fix_impact: Resolves 1×P1 + 2×P2 (auth bypass, DoS, ReDoS) with coordinated update

cross_references.root_cause: Traceability enforcer hardcodes source dirs, ignores config
cross_references.single_fix: Make tools/traceability-enforcer.py read source.dirs from inspector.config.yml
cross_references.fix_impact: Resolves 1×P1 + 1×P3, restores visibility into 92% of codebase
